subject: Kickoff: SolaceHealth capacity review + Executive QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@solacehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: SolaceHealth capacity review + Executive QBR scheduling

Hi Samir / Maya (looping in Laura and Aditya from CS and Sales),

Thanks again for the productive renewal signal last week — excited to get this into motion. I wanted to start a short kickoff thread to align on timeline, stakeholders, and a first pass at the capacity/term changes we discussed:

Summary of ask
- Confirm the requested uplift: +200k monthly tokens (peak bursts up to 400k) and trial of a small Dedicated pool for high-throughput inference.
- Update term/price cadence to reflect 12-month renewal with quarterly usage true-ups.
- Schedule an executive QBR in July to review roadmap, SLOs, and billing expectations.

Proposed immediate next steps (please confirm):
1) You confirm internal stakeholders we should include (procurement, engineering, finance).
2) We run a 48-hr capacity baseline and cost model (attached: 2028_Q3_capacity_plan.xlsx).
3) Schedule a 60-minute Exec QBR during week of Jul 17 — give me 2x preferred windows and we’ll lock one.

Questions for you
- Do you expect sustained uplift or a staged ramp?
- Any compliance or network constraints for a Dedicated pool (VPC peering, SCIM, etc.)?

Attachments: 2028_Q3_capacity_plan.xlsx (baseline + two pricing scenarios)

Thanks — aim is to have procurement-friendly terms and a draft SOW by Jul 3 if we get confirmation this week.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel | Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0196

From: Samir Shah <samir@solacehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Liu <maya.liu@solacehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@solacehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: SolaceHealth capacity review + Executive QBR scheduling

Monica — thanks for pulling this together. Quick answers from our side: 

- Stakeholders: I'll own exec coordination (Samir Shah). Maya Liu (ops lead) will own day-to-day performance. Procurement (procurement@solacehealth.com) will handle contract redlines. I'll also include our platform engineering lead if Dedicated requires VPC work.
- Uplift: We expect a staged ramp: Jul -> +50% (trial), Sep -> full +200k/month. But we need the cost delta for Dedicated vs hosted for the burst profile.
- QBR: Week of Jul 17 is fine. Prefer Tue AM (Jul 18) or Thu PM (Jul 20).

One ask: can you confirm if Redwood can commit to an availability SLA and token-based billing alignment for the Dedicated pool? Procurement will want that in the SOW.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Shah | VP Product | SolaceHealth
samir@solacehealth.com | +1 (650) 444-7788

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@solacehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: SolaceHealth capacity review + Executive QBR scheduling

Samir — thanks for the clarity. Quick pricing and options from Sales: 

Option A (Hosted w/ burst):
- Base: current hosted rate (per-token) applies.
- Burst buffer: add 20% overage pool for predictable burst capacity; no Dedicated setup required.
- Pros: faster, no VPC work.
- Cons: slightly higher per-token cost during sustained load.

Option B (Small Dedicated pool trial):
- Dedicated pool (1-2 GPUs) for predictable throughput. Fixed monthly fee + usage below pool included.
- We'll include a 60-day trial waiver on infra setup fees if you commit to 12-mo term.
- SLA: 99.9% availability SLA; more aggressive SLAs are available under enterprise support (see attached SLA-proposal_v2.pdf).

Next steps we recommend this week:
1) Confirm preferred option (A or B).
2) If B, we kick off VPC/network checklist with your platform eng team (I can get Rishi triaged on the engineering side).
3) We'll finalize pricing and draft SOW for Procurement by Jul 6 to meet your timeline.

Rishi — can you prepare a short VPC checklist we can send to SolaceHealth if they pick Option B?

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (408) 555-0133

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@solacehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: SolaceHealth capacity review + Executive QBR scheduling

Samir / team — happy to run the QBR and the capacity baseline. Couple of practical asks from CS so we can deliver a crisp session: 

Prior to QBR (deliverables we need):
- Last 90 days token/time-series (peak windows + 95th percentile).
- Typical prompt lengths and distribution (for batching/kv-cache assumptions).
- Any recent latency or error spikes (timestamps and traces if available).

Scheduling: Jul 18 Tue 10:00-11:00 PT or Jul 20 Thu 14:00-15:00 PT both work for our execs — Monica, Aditya, and I will be present. Please confirm which slot.

Timeline: If we get the data this week we'll run the baseline, update the attached plan, and aim to deliver a final SOW draft by Jul 6. If Dedicated is chosen, our engineering team (Rishi) will begin the VPC checklist immediately and we estimate a 2-week provisioning window after approvals.

Thanks — looking forward to the QBR.

Best,
Laura Bennett | Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (212) 555-0202
